scope: Current Agent OS source built as an isolated Android validation APK; synthetic acceptance data only.

build.signature_verification: APK v2 and v3 signatures verified

gates.name: Task lifecycle and recovery
gates.evidence: Real UI create/start/pause/resume/complete/cancel flow; process force-stop recovery; full-device reboot recovery from step 1 checkpoint with no duplicate note read and no surviving process-local grant.

gates.name: Broker authorization and audit
gates.evidence: A separately signed synthetic Demo Agent received a real Android approval request. A denial was returned to the caller; a separate five-minute approval permitted the synthetic note read and session ping, and explicit revocation was enforced. Expired authorization was also denied. Traceform provider audit contains denied, granted, invoked, and revoked events.

gates.name: Offline local execution
gates.evidence: System airplane mode was verified on during a two-step local scheduled task; an ungranted capability waited and was audited, then execution completed after a fresh grant. Airplane mode was restored off.
gates.limitation: The app requests and holds INTERNET permission for optional cloud reasoning. This gate proves local completion while airplane mode is enabled; no socket capture was made, so it is not a general zero-egress proof.

gates.name: Memory provenance, migration, and rebuilt index
gates.evidence: On-device v3-to-v4 migration preserved encrypted memory content and assigned legacy provenance; the rebuilt in-memory index found Chinese content and source metadata; encrypted archive export/import preserved the tested records.

gates.name: Import conflicts and deletion tombstones
gates.evidence: Device validation accepted both same-ID conflict choices (keep local or use archive) and confirmed a local deletion tombstone wins over archive content.

gates.name: Optional Traceform provider
gates.evidence: Real UI verified default-off, explicit enable, unauthenticated denial, a task-scoped five-minute grant, a read of a bounded local-history simulation summary, user-confirmed save as a fact memory, explicit revoke, and default-off cleanup. The returned summary states it is not a validated prediction or causal effect.
gates.boundary: No direct Traceform database access or sensor collection was used.

gates.name: Power, background policy, and permission record
gates.evidence: A 28-second, screen-on, simulated-unplug task sample and standby-bucket snapshot were recorded. See phase1_rerun_20261024_battery_measurement.json.
gates.limitation: The UID estimate is display-dominated and does not isolate background compute or predict runtime. The standby bucket was ACTIVE. INTERNET was granted; overlay/accessibility-related AppOps were not all denied.

cleanup.production_packages: The validation run installed and exercised only the isolated target package; Traceform production packages were not targeted.
